explication: This repository is a collection of local-first creator and research skills, not one runtime application. Users invoke individual skills for publishing, media processing, research, search, and local messaging-data workflows; results include drafts, archives, reports, and exports. The graph groups those independent capabilities. Internal edges are limited to dependencies named in the source index; README-described capabilities with no sampled implementation are represented only where an exact path is present in the tree. Some README capabilities have no corresponding source file in the supplied tree and are omitted.
